why: ⚠ AFTER `build`, BECAUSE IT ASKS THE BUILT FILE. `tickcheck` reads `dist/mclite.html` and asks whether the game's loop actually calls every per-tick entry point — the question that would have caught a scheduler nothing ever drained (D-301).
